items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Well then he says you went with after that you went with Bill Coleman, toured with Bill Coleman? [INTERVIEWEE] Yes, that's right.

ctx.x: They had it fixed sort of like New Orleans and when you walked in they had big white horses on each side you know. Oh it was a ....... But no gambling. You could not gamble in there.
Well then he says you went with after that you went with Bill Coleman, toured with Bill Coleman?
Yes, that's right. While I was over there with Mezz.
